name: 張詠翔
objective:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
schedule:
This course is designed to strengthen students' academic English skills through reading materials specific to their fields of studies and to familiarize students with useful expressions in conversations/presentations to build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication.

Weeks 1-4: Unit 4
Weeks 5-8: Unit 7
Weeks 9-13: Unit 10
Weeks 14-17: Unit 12
Week 18: Thursday: Individual appointments (General Building Room #803); Friday: no class
scorePolicy:
English proficiency test 20%
Oral presentation 40%
Attendance 20%
Class participation, activities & quizzes 20%
materials: Capstone: English for Information and New Technology by S. Kenny, E. Sabaino, & J. Bondar. Crane Publishing
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL / 專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
